notes.subject: o a kgothaletša mang
notes.rationale: Mašaledi a nyaka: magoshi a Yisraele goba moprofeta yena — 'koala bosupi' a bolela go e hwetša goba go e uta?

notes.subject: ka nnoto Torah
notes.rationale: Go ka nnota ga Torah goswa lebaka la dilo tša ka morago — sengwalwa se se kwalelego.

notes.subject: Torah
notes.rationale: Torah e dula e le Torah go ya ka D2 — e sego 'molao' fela.

translation: Koala bosupi; ka nnoto ⟨את⟩ Torah gare ga ba ba rutwago ka nna.

tokens.gloss: gare ga ba ba rutwago ka nna
